## Campaign Rationale — January 2026 Planning Cycle

The Cumin/Gujarat segment (54 growers, avg score 0.333) was prioritised based on seasonal alignment with the cumin cultivation window in Gujarat, where January represents a critical crop protection intervention period ahead of key disease and pest pressure phases. WhatsApp-plus-offline reinforcement as the channel mix reflects growers in this segment showing responsiveness to digital outreach combined with field-level touchpoints, maximising engagement probability for Score 250 EC recommendations. No OOS blocks were triggered in this cycle, meaning the full 54-grower target pool is cleared for activation without inventory-related attrition risk — field teams can commit to conversion efforts without the complication of managing unmet demand. With a clean inventory position and a focused single-segment push, field teams should target a **25–35% conversion rate** on this cohort, translating to approximately 13–19 grower conversions, with WhatsApp serving as the primary lead-nurturing channel and offline reinforcement closing undecided growers through direct agronomic engagement.
